messages:
Priya: Heads up — prepping relnotes for next docs deploy (v0.9.7). Need final snippet sync for the streaming embeddings migration and the SDK examples in python/js.

Elaine: Which snippet specifically? the migration guide in /docs/migrations or the examples under /examples/embed?

Priya: Both. Main scope:
- one concise changelog bullet: 'streaming embeddings deprecated — migrate to embeddings.v2 or non-streaming flows'
- a short migration guide with tiny python + js snippets
- known-issue blurb: older streaming clients (<=0.6.x) can get truncated responses (400)

Kevin: I can update the python example. Will switch to batch->single call pattern. Quick draft: 
```
from redwood import Embeddings
emb = Embeddings()
resp = emb.create(input=["a","b"], model="embed-v2")
```

Priya: Nice. Please also add a one-liner about normalizing inputs (trim/lower) and a tiny cache-key example.

Kevin: Will do — plan to add a 1-line cache note and a 1-line normalization snippet.

Josh (SDK): I'll patch the JS example. Use the modern client shape: 
```
const { Embeddings } = require('@redwood/inference')
const e = new Embeddings()
await e.create({ input: ['a','b'], model: 'embed-v2' })
```

Priya: Also need a short known-issues blurb: 'Older streaming clients (<=0.6.x) may see truncated streams; update to >=0.7.0 or call non-streaming embeddings.' Keep it plain.

Elaine: Found a bad link in migrations -> points to /docs/kv-cache-old.md. I'll swap to /docs/kv-cache.md in the PR.

Priya: Great. Assign reviewers: @doc-squad, @sdk-team. Target merge: EOD tomorrow. Any blockers?

Elaine: Blocked on screenshots from QA (console rollout card). QA says they can provide by noon tomorrow.

Josh (SDK): Pinged QA for the screenshot. Also let's add a fallback snippet showing server-side dedup to avoid double-embedding on retries — 2 lines max.

Priya: Good call. Keep it tiny. I'll draft the changelog bullets after PRs land and paste into the release notes doc.

Doc-Bot: PR 4219 opened by @kevin — docs/migrations/streaming-embeds.md

Kevin: PR up — includes python snippet, cache note, and a rendering test for the example. Link: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/4219

Elaine: Updated the migration guide link and pushed an image placeholder -> https://img.redwood/c/rollout-card-v2.png

Josh (SDK): PR 4220 opened for JS snippet + server-side dedup example.

Priya: Thanks. If PRs merge I'll do a final wording pass and send to PMs for signoff. Post any microcopy suggestions here.

Elaine: Small nit — prefer 'streaming embeddings' over 'embed streaming' across docs for clarity.

Priya: Noted. I'll normalize phrasing in relnotes and migration guide.

Kevin: Fixed wording and added a tiny unit test reference. @doc-squad please review when you can.

Lisa (doc-squad): Reviewing now — found a small typo in a code comment. I'll push a minor fix.

Lisa (doc-squad): LGTM after the fix. :thumbsup:

Priya: Closing checklist: 
- [x] python snippet (kevin)
- [x] js snippet (josh)
- [x] link fix (elaine)
- [~] screenshots (qa)
- [x] known-issues blurb

Doc-Bot: PR 4219 merged by @kevin

Priya: PRs merged for the migration guide and snippets. I'll paste final bullets into the relnotes draft and send for PM signoff. Thanks everyone!

Josh (SDK): thanks all :party_parrot:
